name: Last Kiss Before Summer
source: An unknown illness has gripped you since birth, stranding you indoors most of your life. Despite this, you've spent your days happily learning about the world around you. But recently, your illness has progressed rapidly, leaving you with only 33 days left to live! Determined to make the most of your time, you enroll in school and seek out experiences you’ve never had before—like love. Will your last days be as blissful as you’d hoped?
translation: 从出生起，一种未知的疾病就一直困扰着你，将你一生的大部分时间困在室内。尽管如此，你还是快乐地度过了这些日子，了解周围的世界。但最近，你的病情急剧恶化，只剩下33天的生命了！你决定充分利用你的时间，进入学校并寻找你以前从未有过的经历——比如爱情。你最后的日子会像你希望的那样幸福吗？
